34/// A trait for PDF objects.
35pub(crate) trait ObjectLike<'a>: TryFrom<Object<'a>> + Readable<'a> + Debug + Clone {
36    /// PdfCraft patch (32): whether this is several items of an array, read one by one (a tuple).
37    /// Such a thing can't itself be given by reference, so one at its start is its first item's.
38    const GROUP: bool = false;
39}
40
41/// A trait for PDF objects that can be borrowed directly from an [`Object`].
42pub(crate) trait ObjectRefLike<'a>: Sized {
43    fn cast_ref<'b>(obj: &'b Object<'a>) -> Option<&'b Self>;
44}

46/// A primitive PDF object.
47#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
48pub enum Object<'a> {
49    /// A null object.
50    Null(Null),
51    /// A boolean object.
52    Boolean(bool),
53    /// A number object.
54    Number(Number),
55    /// A string object.
56    String(String<'a>),
57    /// A name object.
58    Name(Name<'a>),
59    /// A dict object.
60    Dict(Dict<'a>),
61    /// An array object.
62    Array(Array<'a>),
63    /// A stream object.
64    // Can only be an indirect object in theory and thus comes with some caveats,
65    // but we just treat it the same.
66    Stream(Stream<'a>),
67}
68
69impl<'a> Object<'a> {
70    /// Try casting the object to a specific subtype.
71    pub(crate) fn cast<T>(self) -> Option<T>
72    where
73        T: ObjectLike<'a>,
74    {
75        self.try_into().ok()
76    }
77
78    /// Try casting the object to a reference of the specific type.
79    pub(crate) fn cast_ref<T>(&self) -> Option<&T>
80    where
81        T: ObjectRefLike<'a>,
82    {
83        T::cast_ref(self)
84    }
85
86    /// Try casting the object to a dict.
87    #[inline(always)]
88    pub fn into_dict(self) -> Option<Dict<'a>> {
89        self.cast()
90    }
91
92    /// Try casting the object to a name.
93    #[inline(always)]
94    pub fn into_name(self) -> Option<Name<'a>> {
95        self.cast()
96    }
97
98    /// Try casting the object to the null object.
99    #[inline(always)]
100    pub fn into_null(self) -> Option<Null> {
101        self.cast()
102    }
103
104    /// Try casting the object to a bool.
105    #[inline(always)]
106    pub fn into_bool(self) -> Option<bool> {
107        self.cast()
108    }
109
110    /// Try casting the object to a string.
111    #[inline(always)]
112    pub fn into_string(self) -> Option<String<'a>> {
113        self.cast()
114    }
115
116    /// Try casting the object to a stream.
117    #[inline(always)]
118    pub fn into_stream(self) -> Option<Stream<'a>> {
119        self.cast()
120    }
121
122    /// Try casting the object to an array.
123    #[inline(always)]
124    pub fn into_array(self) -> Option<Array<'a>> {
125        self.cast()
126    }
127
128    /// Try casting the object to a u8.
129    #[inline(always)]
130    pub fn into_u8(self) -> Option<u8> {
131        self.cast()
132    }
133
134    /// Try casting the object to a u16.
135    #[inline(always)]
136    pub fn into_u16(self) -> Option<u16> {
137        self.cast()
138    }
139
140    /// Try casting the object to a f32.
141    #[inline(always)]
142    pub fn into_f32(self) -> Option<f32> {
143        self.cast()
144    }
145
146    /// Try casting the object to a i32.
147    #[inline(always)]
148    pub fn into_i32(self) -> Option<i32> {
149        self.cast()
150    }
151
152    /// Try casting the object to a number.
153    #[inline(always)]
154    pub fn into_number(self) -> Option<Number> {
155        self.cast()
156    }

159impl<'a> ObjectLike<'a> for Object<'a> {}
160impl<'a> ObjectRefLike<'a> for Object<'a> {
161    fn cast_ref(obj: &Self) -> Option<&Self> {
162        Some(obj)
163    }
164}

166impl Skippable for Object<'_> {
167    fn skip(r: &mut Reader<'_>, is_content_stream: bool) -> Option<()> {
168        match r.peek_byte()? {
169            b'n' => Null::skip(r, is_content_stream),
170            b't' | b'f' => bool::skip(r, is_content_stream),
171            b'/' => Name::skip(r, is_content_stream),
172            b'<' => match r.peek_bytes(2)? {
173                // A stream can never appear in a dict/array, so it should never be skipped.
174                b"<<" => Dict::skip(r, is_content_stream),
175                _ => String::skip(r, is_content_stream),
176            },
177            b'(' => String::skip(r, is_content_stream),
178            b'.' | b'+' | b'-' | b'0'..=b'9' => Number::skip(r, is_content_stream),
179            b'[' => Array::skip(r, is_content_stream),
180            // See test case operator-in-TJ-array-0: Be lenient and skip content operators in
181            // array
182            _ => skip_name_like(r, false),
183        }
184    }
185}
186
187impl<'a> Readable<'a> for Object<'a> {
188    fn read(r: &mut Reader<'a>, ctx: &ReaderContext<'a>) -> Option<Self> {
189        let object = match r.peek_byte()? {
190            b'n' => Self::Null(Null::read(r, ctx)?),
191            b't' | b'f' => Self::Boolean(bool::read(r, ctx)?),
192            b'/' => Self::Name(Name::read(r, ctx)?),
193            b'<' => match r.peek_bytes(2)? {
194                b"<<" => {
195                    let mut cloned = r.clone();
196                    let dict = Dict::read(&mut cloned, ctx);
197                    cloned.skip_white_spaces_and_comments();
198                    let is_stream = cloned.forward_tag(b"stream").is_some();
199                    // PdfCraft patch: what the clone looked at past the end counts for `r` too.
200                    r.absorb_past_end(&cloned);
201                    let dict = dict?;
202
203                    if is_stream {
204                        Object::Stream(Stream::read(r, ctx)?)
205                    } else {
206                        r.jump(cloned.offset());
207
208                        Object::Dict(dict)
209                    }
210                }
211                _ => Self::String(String::read(r, ctx)?),
212            },
213            b'(' => Self::String(String::read(r, ctx)?),
214            b'.' | b'+' | b'-' | b'0'..=b'9' => Self::Number(Number::read(r, ctx)?),
215            b'[' => Self::Array(Array::read(r, ctx)?),
216            // See the comment in `skip`.
217            _ => {
218                skip_name_like(r, false)?;
219                Self::Null(Null)
220            }
221        };
222
223        Some(object)
224    }
225}

227/// A trait for objects that can be parsed from a simple byte stream.
228pub trait FromBytes<'a>: Sized {
229    /// Try to read the object from the given bytes.
230    fn from_bytes(b: &'a [u8]) -> Option<Self>;
231}
232
233impl<'a, T: Readable<'a>> FromBytes<'a> for T {
234    fn from_bytes(b: &'a [u8]) -> Option<Self> {
235        Self::from_bytes_impl(b)
236    }
237}

239/// An identifier for a PDF object.
240#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
241pub struct ObjectIdentifier {
242    /// The object number.
243    pub obj_number: i32,
244    /// The generation number.
245    pub gen_number: i32,
246}
247
248impl ObjectIdentifier {
249    /// Create a new `ObjectIdentifier`.
250    pub fn new(obj_number: i32, gen_number: i32) -> Self {
251        Self { obj_number, gen_number }
252    }
253}
254
255impl Readable<'_> for ObjectIdentifier {
256    fn read(r: &mut Reader<'_>, _: &ReaderContext<'_>) -> Option<Self> {
257        let obj_number = r.read_without_context::<i32>()?;
258        r.skip_white_spaces_and_comments();
259        let gen_number = r.read_without_context::<i32>()?;
260        r.skip_white_spaces_and_comments();
261        r.forward_tag(b"obj")?;
262
263        Some(Self { obj_number, gen_number })
264    }
265}
266
267impl Skippable for ObjectIdentifier {
268    fn skip(r: &mut Reader<'_>, _: bool) -> Option<()> {
269        r.skip::<i32>(false)?;
270        r.skip_white_spaces_and_comments();
271        r.skip::<i32>(false)?;
272        r.skip_white_spaces_and_comments();
273        r.forward_tag(b"obj")?;
274
275        Some(())
276    }
277}

279/// A convenience function that extracts a dict and a stream from an object.
280/// If the object is just a dictionary, it will return `None` for the stream.
281/// If the object is a stream, it will return its dictionary as well as the stream
282/// itself.
283pub fn dict_or_stream<'a, 'b>(obj: &'b Object<'a>) -> Option<(&'b Dict<'a>, Option<&'b Stream<'a>>)> {
284    if let Some(stream) = obj.cast_ref::<Stream<'a>>() {
285        Some((stream.dict(), Some(stream)))
286    } else {
287        obj.cast_ref::<Dict<'a>>().map(|dict| (dict, None))
288    }
289}

291mod macros {
292    macro_rules! object {
293        ($t:ident $(<$l:lifetime>),*, $s:ident) => {
294            impl<'a> TryFrom<Object<'a>> for $t$(<$l>),* {
295                type Error = ();
296
297                fn try_from(value: Object<'a>) -> core::result::Result<Self, Self::Error> {
298                    match value {
299                        Object::$s(b) => Ok(b),
300                        _ => Err(()),
301                    }
302                }
303            }
304
305            impl<'a> crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectLike<'a> for $t$(<$l>),* {}
306
307            impl<'a> crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectRefLike<'a> for $t$(<$l>),* {
308                fn cast_ref<'b>(obj: &'b crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Object<'a>) -> Option<&'b Self> {
309                    match obj {
310                        crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Object::$s(b) => Some(b),
311                        _ => None,
312                    }
313                }
314            }
315        };
316    }
317
318    pub(crate) use object;
319}

321#[cfg(any())]
322mod tests {
323    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::{Array, Dict, Name, Null, Number, Object, Stream, String};
324    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::reader::Reader;
325    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::reader::{ReaderContext, ReaderExt};
326
327    fn object_impl(data: &[u8]) -> Option<Object<'_>> {
328        let mut r = Reader::new(data);
329        r.read_with_context::<Object<'_>>(&ReaderContext::dummy())
330    }
331
332    #[cfg(any())]
333    fn null() {
334        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"null").unwrap(), Object::Null(_)));
335    }
336
337    #[cfg(any())]
338    fn bool() {
339        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"true").unwrap(), Object::Boolean(_)));
340    }
341
342    #[cfg(any())]
343    fn number() {
344        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"34.5").unwrap(), Object::Number(_)));
345    }
346
347    #[cfg(any())]
348    fn string_1() {
349        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"(Hi)").unwrap(), Object::String(_)));
350    }
351
352    #[cfg(any())]
353    fn string_2() {
354        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"<34>").unwrap(), Object::String(_)));
355    }
356
357    #[cfg(any())]
358    fn name() {
359        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"/Name").unwrap(), Object::Name(_)));
360    }
361
362    #[cfg(any())]
363    fn dict() {
364        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"<</Entry 45>>").unwrap(), Object::Dict(_)));
365    }
366
367    #[cfg(any())]
368    fn array() {
369        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"[45]").unwrap(), Object::Array(_)));
370    }
371
372    #[cfg(any())]
373    fn stream() {
374        assert!(matches!(object_impl(b"<< /Length 3 >> stream\nabc\nendstream").unwrap(), Object::Stream(_)));
375    }
376
377    #[cfg(any())]
378    #[cfg(target_pointer_width = "64")]
379    fn object_sizes() {
380        assert_eq!(size_of::<Object<'_>>(), 40);
381        assert_eq!(size_of::<Array<'_>>(), 32);
382        assert_eq!(size_of::<Dict<'_>>(), 8);
383        assert_eq!(size_of::<Name<'_>>(), 32);
384        assert_eq!(size_of::<Null>(), 0);
385        assert_eq!(size_of::<Number>(), 16);
386        assert_eq!(size_of::<Stream<'_>>(), 24);
387        assert_eq!(size_of::<String<'_>>(), 32);
388    }
